tagline: Learn design patterns with depth, not flashcards.
dashboard.subtitle: Assemble pattern structure like developer LEGO — then prove it in code and refactors.
dashboard.playHint: Drop into the Practice Arena and build the runtime shape hands-on.
dashboard.empty: No patterns loaded yet. Check that the API is running.
explorer.title: Pattern Explorer
explorer.subtitle: Filter by category or search by name and intent.
detail.error: Pattern not found or API unreachable.
detail.locked: Locked — earn more XP or finish two patterns to unlock.
practice.title: Practice Arena
practice.subtitle: Build, connect, and run pattern structure — Block, Code, and Refactor modes with XP that sticks.
practice.empty: No exercises for this level yet.
arena.canvasEmpty: Click pieces to place them on the canvas
arena.connectHint: Select a block, then another to wire the relation
arena.flowDone: Flow complete — structure behaves like the pattern.
arena.submitError: Could not save arena progress — is the API up?
arena.feedback.ok: Structure matches the pattern. Run the flow to watch it execute.
arena.feedback.distractor: A distractor piece is on the board — remove roles that do not belong.
arena.feedback.missingRole: A required role is missing. Pull every core piece from the palette.
arena.feedback.badEdges: Relations incomplete ({{have}}/{{need}}). Check extends / implements / creates / wraps / notifies.
arena.code.ok: Snippet compiles in your head — blanks match the pattern.
arena.code.hint: Re-read the factory/adapter/observer hook names and try again.
arena.refactor.brief: Select the moves that apply this pattern cleanly. Wrong moves cost quality.
arena.refactor.ok: Clean refactor path — the smell is contained by the pattern.
arena.refactor.bad: Quality score is soft. Prefer pattern-aligned moves and drop the traps.
progress.title: Progress & Achievements
progress.subtitle: XP for understanding, not click spam. Streaks pause instead of punishing.
progress.none: Complete a lesson or quiz to unlock your first badge.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Language, learning depth, motion, and theme stay on this device.
settings.levelHelp: Changes explanation depth, examples, and exercises — not just a label.
coming.soon.body: Compare Patterns depth and more GoF catalogs arrive later.
